name: Performance Analysis
description: Deep dive into clutch performances and statistical anomalies

commands.name: clutch
commands.description: Analyze clutch performance in high-pressure situations
commands.longDescription: Analyze how managers perform in critical situations: playoffs, close games, and high-stakes matchups.

examples.output:
Playoff Performance Rankings:
1. AJ Boorde: 15-5 (75%)
2. Nixon Ball: 12-6 (67%)

Close Game Performance (games within 10 points):
Shows win rates in nail-biters

tips: Playoffs: Performance in playoff weeks only
Close: Games decided by less than 10 points
High Stakes: Playoff implications on the line

commands.name: cursed
commands.description: Reveal fantasy football curses and statistical nightmares
commands.longDescription: Uncover the worst luck, biggest chokes, and most cursed moments for a specific manager.

examples.output:
🔮 Curse Report for Mike Simpson:
- Times scored 2nd highest and lost: 12
- Worst playoff exit: Lost by 0.5 pts in semis
- Most points left on bench: 147.3

tips: Shows unlucky losses, bench disasters, and heartbreaking moments
